description: Utah Hazard Planning Dashboard is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Western Water Assessment; Southern Climate Impacts Planning Program. This online dashboard compiles interactive information, tools, maps, and graphics about natural hazards in Utah. Input from hazard planners and providers of hazard information helped identify the best available information about the historical incidence, current risk and future projections of natural hazards for the state. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Landslides, Severe Winter Weather, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
